experiment: Step 2A — Stepped Connection-Pressure Survival & Automatic Recovery
failure_criterion: Any 5-second (10-probe) window during active connection pressure with < 80% valid HTTP 200 responses, or >= 3 consecutive failed probes (HTTP 5xx or timeout), or SSH probe timeout.
sustained_recovery_criterion: 15 consecutive seconds (30/30 probes at 2 RPS) of 100% valid HTTP 200 responses with 0 timeouts and no manual intervention.

methodology_corrections_note: 1. Every configuration returned 40/40 valid HTTP 200 responses during active load and 30/30 during post-load recovery; these trials demonstrate responsiveness under single-source connection pressure rather than a reproduced server crash. 2. Original `reached_failure_threshold` (HTTP 200 outage) is preserved alongside explicitly separated failure flags (`explicit_failure_criteria`). 3. Post-load HTTP 200 availability is separated from recovery to a 15-second (30-probe) consecutive `<= 500 ms` streak (`recovery_timeline_analysis`). 4. Two source IP paths were used: direct-to-origin (`<CLIENT_LOAD_IP>`) for load generation and SSH probes, and Cloudflare dynamic pass-through (`cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC`) for legitimate visitor HTTPS probes.
